text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! Her legs look so baboom! And her shoulders are on show like dadam! Isn't this outfit super mature?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Wow, mature? Sure. But that's really,
well,
adventurous... It's way too soon for
Mayano to be
wearing this.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Think I'm gonna buy it! ☆ Hehe,
everyone's gonna
be shocked by how
grown-up I'll look!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What?! Um... Hey, forget that! Check
this out. It's
a midi skirt, and the design's
really cute.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh... But right now, I'd rather look
cool than
cute. I'm looking for mature
designs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's mature-casual, Mayano. Real adults
cover up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep... Real adults know when to keep
things
hidden... and that's what makes
them the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Hiding secrets really does
sound
super cool.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Palmer! Hehe, I'm gonna get the
skirt! ♪
